provider_provenance.description: Provider provenance record from the Pass-2 verify agent step (resolved provider/model, the endpoint actually called, the effective capability record). Carried onto the verdict, never recomputed here. Null when the runner resolved no provider (e.g. the fake runner) — the verdict then omits the key.
